summary: Completed testing of firewall enable-rack feature. All backend API tests passed (7/7). Frontend tests passed - firewall toggle button in ServerRackView rack detail panel works correctly, showing appropriate states (Enable Firewall, Enable All Firewalls, Protected — Disable Firewall) and successfully toggling firewall status for all sites in a rack.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firewall enable-rack feature fully functional. The Clara Health Scan modal appears after login and blocks interaction - use sessionStorage.setItem('clara_health_scan_YYYY-MM-DD', 'dismissed') to bypass it during testing.
